To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The natural frequencies of a mechanical system consisting of N components with piecewise constant properties can be calculated using a set of transcendential equations that relate the thickness and elastic modulii of layers and (2) the effective model of wave propagation in such a system gives a priori qualitative understanding of the natural frequencies changes and allows one to calculate the natural frequencies quantitatively.
the normal mode frequencies of a mechanical system composed of N layers with piecewise constant properties can be expressed in terms of the normal mode frequencies in the absence of any layers.

we have derived a set of transcendential equations for the normal frequencies of a one-dimensional mechanical system composed of arbitrary number of layers and provided experimental validation for the special case of a two-layer system consisting of a partially submerged fiber.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of an effective model for the wave propagation in mechanical systems composed of an arbitrary numbers of layers with different mechanical properties and the experimental validation of the derived model.
the study of the fundamental frequencies and wave propagation of mechanical systems with a large number of piecewise constant parameters.

the study of the normal modes of mechanical systems composed of an arbitrary finite number of layers with different properties and the derivation of the transcendental equations that relate the normal modes to the properties of layers.

the analytical model presented here provides a simple and effective method for the determination of the elastic modulus and thickness of a thin film.
the proposed approach is a very useful tool for studying the dynamics of mechanical systems consisting of an arbitrary number (N) of components with piecewise constant elastic moduli and thickness.
this work presents a novel method of measuring thickness and elastic modulus of thin films using the fundamental frequencies of a mechanical system with N piecewise properties.

the presented model allows to calculate the fundamental frequencies of the mechanical system with N piecewise linear properties.
